item.title: Top Ranked Bradley Central Holds Off Rival Cleveland 57-55
item.description: Cleveland, TN-(WDEF-TV) Top ranked Bradley Central nearly squandered a 21-point lead in the fourth quarter before holding on to beat rival Cleveland 57-55. The Bearettes had to play the final minutes of the game without Clemson signee Kimora Fields, who was ejected after an interaction with a Cleveland player. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Chattanooga Native And Utah Jazz Rookie Ace Bailey Enjoys Homecoming in Atlanta
item.description: Atlanta, GA-(WDEF-TV) Chattanooga native and NBA rookie Ace Bailey got to play close to home last night as the Utah Jazz visited Atlanta. Bailey is averaging 11-points a game, but his family support must have inspired him against the Hawks, as he pumped in 20-points. Brian Armstrong caught up with the Jazz guard. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Nationally Ranked La Lumiere Downs McCallie 80-40 in the Dr. Pepper Classic
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) McCallie welcomed some of the nation’s top high school basketball teams back to Chattanooga for their annual Dr. Pepper Classic. The Blue Tornado opened on Friday against 13th ranked La Lumiere, and McCallie fell by a final score of 80-40. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
